behavior: Form pages fill the content width: full-width panels with paired fields instead of a fixed narrow column
acceptance: Form pages (New invoice, Request money, New job, New and Edit client, Billing details, New profile, Email notifications) fill the content width at 1024, 1280, 1440 and 1920 px: no fixed narrow column with empty space beside it; screenshots in docs/runs

notes: 2026-10-19 review pass by reviewer: No blockers. Layout-only change. Field names, ids, labels, the amount/items swap and its focus effect, the any-token mode and the request branches behave as before. Billing details now reads name, email, address, country, tax ID; first-invalid focus follows that DOM order, which is the reading order. empty:hidden works: JSX drops whitespace between the two conditional children, so the grid is :empty when both are null. The request-1440 shot shows the empty Details and Dates rows take no room. Phones (390) stay one column with no sideways scroll in the shots. No in-app form page keeps a fixed narrow column; sign-in, consent and first-run sit outside the app shell. Tokens only, no raw px. (3) new-invoice-form.tsx:465 comment opens with what the row does; keep only the why for empty:hidden. (4) client-screen.tsx:44 wrapper div now has no class. (5) No request-1280 after-shot.
